text: # Moderation Arena — User Guide Each round shows you **one social media post** and the moderation decisions that **two different platform policies** produced for it. You compare the two decisions and tell us which one you prefer. ⚠️ Posts are sampled from real platform data and may contain graphic, sexual, violent or hateful content. --- ## 1. The post The post (text, and any images or video) appears at the top. Media is **collapsed by default** — click **▶ Show media** to expand it. For videos and posts with audio, the **audio transcript** is shown below the media. Use **Translate to English** under the post text or the transcript to open Google Translate in a new tab. ## 2. Policy A and Policy B The same AI model (Gemma) judged the post under two different policies. Which policy is which is **hidden** (blind), and the left/right order is random. The two decisions are laid out **row by row**, Policy A on the left and Policy B on the right: | Row | What it shows | |-----|---------------| | **Label** | The moderation label assigned under that policy (*no-moderation* if the policy allows the post), with the model's confidence | | **Action** | The moderation action the policy would apply (e.g. *Remove Content*, *Restrict Reach*, *Warn*) — *No action* if none | | **Policy quotes** | The excerpts of the policy the model cited for its decision | | **Explanation** | A short justification of the decision | **Show full policy** above each column opens the complete text of that policy. ## 3. Your preference In the middle column of the **Label**, **Action** and **Policy quotes** rows, choose **A**, **Both**, **Neither** or **B**: * **Label** — which policy's label fits the post better? * **Action** — which policy's action is more appropriate? * **Policy quotes** — which policy's quotes better justify the decision? *Both* means the two are equally good, *Neither* that neither is good. When all three rows are marked, click **Submit vote**. The policies are revealed, and **Next post** takes you to the next sample. **Skip** loads a different post without voting. ## 4. Your name You enter your name when you start. Your votes are saved under it, and entering the same name again continues where you left off. **Change name** in the sidebar signs you out so someone else can start. ## 5. Dark / light mode Use the toggle in the sidebar. Your choice is remembered in the browser.
